title: Very pleasant yoga session!
text:
Very pleasant moment with stunning sea views! Thank you to Sandra for this moment of relaxation!
Remember to take sunscreen, sunglasses and a cap because the sun is rather strong even in the early morning!
author: carlacS5929VW

title: Peaceful and beautiful experience
text:
We had a good experience participating in Yoga by the sea with Sandra as instructor. The class was primarily in Spanish, with some english instructions. Sandra made it easy to understand and follow. The introduction of the yoga practice  was in Spanish - perhaps a written short version in English through the booking app could be sent to foreign speaking participants.
It was a wonderful experience at the brink of the ocean with the sun setting in the background.
author: Anne_M

title: Beautiful, Peaceful Practice by the Sea
text: Such a lovely class overlooking the sea on a beautiful morning. Sandra is such a kind, gentle, empathetic, and wonderful teacher and practitioner. This was my first yoga class after a serious injury and Sandra made me feel welcome and right at home. The beautiful, peaceful setting was the cherry on top. Thank you, Sandra, and Barcelona. Love from New York!
author: Melissa_D

title: Fantastic start to a Sunday morning in Barcelona
text: Yoga by the sea with Sandra was a wonderful start to the Sunday in Barcelona. Great class, instruction in English and Spanish which was amazing. Brilliant flow for beginners and more advanced. Highly recommend
author: Helen_C

title: Great atmosphere by the sea
text: Loved the parctice! Good communication altough I don't speak spanish, she did the most in english, and you don't have to be a pro to be able to follow. Really nice atmosphere!
author: juliacO7353KT

title: Great yoga class with Sandra at barceloneta beach!
text: Yoga in a beautiful location on the beach of Barceloneta. Sandra is a pleasant and good yoga teacher. She takes into account the different yoga levels of the participants and makes suggestions to improve a posture. She also explains well (via WhatsApp) how to get to the yoga location. Recommended!
author: Robert188572
